content: Depending on configuration parameter DcmDspSessionFor- Boot , either the application shall send the positive response (if suppressPosRspMs- gIndicationBit = FALSE) or after an ECU reset, when the bootloader is started, it shall send a response and clear the ResponseRequired flag. In either case, the bootloader shall clear the ReprogramingRequest flag.
